_comment: What AlfieBot says in the spelling tutor. Several options per line; one is picked at random. Placeholders: {word}, {Word} (capital first letter), {letters} (B-E-C-A-U-S-E), {slow_letters}, {n}, {total}, {count}, {score}, {first}, {length}, {pattern}, {answer}, {missed}.
menu_question: Would you like to add this week's spellings, practise them or take a test?
Shall we add spellings, practise them or do a test?
menu_unclear: Sorry, would you like to add spellings, practise them or take a test? Or say stop to finish.
Hmm, shall we add words, practise or do a test?
no_words: We haven't got any spellings saved yet. Shall we add some? Say add the word, then your word, or type them into the spelling panel.
There aren't any spellings to use yet. Let's add some first! Say add the word, then your word.
add_intro: Let's add this week's spellings! Say add the word, then your word. Say finished when you're done.
Ready to add words! Tell me each one like this: add the word because. Say finished when you're done.
add_saved: Great! I've added {word} to your list. What's the next word?
Done! {Word} is on your list. What's next?
Got it, {word} is saved. Next word, or say finished.
add_already: {Word} is already on your list! What's the next word?
add_retry: Oops! Let's try again. Can you spell it for me, letter by letter?
Sorry about that! Please spell the word for me, one letter at a time.
add_unclear: Sorry, I didn't catch the word. Say add the word, then the word. Or say finished.
Hmm, which word shall I add? Say add the word, then the word.
add_done: Brilliant! This week's list has {count} words. Would you like to practise them or take a test?
All saved! You've got {count} words this week. Shall we practise them or do a test?
add_done_empty: Okay! We didn't add any new words. Would you like to practise or take a test?
yes_or_no: Is that right? Yes or no?
practice_intro: Practice time! We've got {total} words to learn.
practice_word: Word {n} of {total} is {word}. {Word} is spelled {letters}. Now you try! Spell {word}.
Here's word {n} of {total}: {word}. It's spelled {letters}. Your turn! Spell {word}.
practice_slow: Okay, nice and slowly. {Word}. {slow_letters} Now you try!
clue_1: Here's a clue. {Word} starts with {first} and has {length} letters.
Clue time! It begins with {first}, and it has {length} letters.
clue_3: Last clue: {word} is spelled {letters}. Have a go!
practice_wrong: Nearly! You spelled {answer}. {Word} is spelled {letters}. Have another go!
Good try! Let's look again: {word} is {letters}. Try once more!
So close! It's {letters}. You can do it, try again!
practice_give_up: That one's tricky! It's {letters}. We'll practise {word} again another time.
Tricky word! {Word} is {letters}. Let's come back to it later.
practice_done: That's all {total} words! You got {score} right first time. Would you like to take a test now?
We've practised all {total} words, and {score} were right first time. Shall we do a test?
test_intro: Spelling test time! I'll say each word, and you spell it. There are {total} words.
Let's do a test! I'll say a word and you spell it. {total} words. Here we go!
test_wrong: Not quite, but well done for trying. It's {letters}.
test_skip: No problem. {Word} is spelled {letters}. We'll practise it later.
test_done_all: You got all {total} right! Amazing spelling!
Wow, {total} out of {total}! Every single one!
test_done_some: You got {score} out of {total}! Great effort. Let's practise {missed} again. Would you like to practise {them} now?
{score} out of {total}, well done! The tricky {ones} {were} {missed}. Shall we practise {them} now?
test_stopped: Okay, we'll stop the test there. You got {score} out of {n}. Great effort!
confirm_heard: I heard {letters}. Is that what you meant?
heard_retry: Okay, spell it again for me, letter by letter.
No problem, try spelling it again.
nothing_heard: I didn't catch any letters. Try spelling it again, letter by letter.
start_again: Okay, let's start again from the beginning.
stop: Okay, we'll stop there. Great work today!
